'''Phluche's Hydrobikes''' was a business operating in the town of [[Le Yer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]]. Run by the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Phluche Maltrid]], the business rented [[hydrobike]]s to tourists.<ref name="AI" />
